query: What repercussions occur when the same real estate is filed with multiple authorities?
reference_answer:
Dual Registration of Same Property:
The penalty can include imprisonment up to 7 years and/or a fine, under Section 467 of the IPC for forgery of valuable security, and also attract penalties under the Registration Act, 1908.
answer: When the same real estate is filed with multiple authorities, it can lead to legal complications and delays in transactions. Each authority may have different rules and requirements, leading to potential disputes over ownership or rights to the property. [System]
